comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: The cultural diversity of the Omo Valley is fascinating, but I wonder how local communities feel about becoming destinations for international visitors. Does tourism create meaningful opportunities for families while helping preserve traditions, or can it put pressure on people to present their culture mainly for cameras? I'd really value a local perspective.
